title: ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
Article 11 (Painting and Marking of Fire Equipment) (1) Painting and marking of fire equipment shall be decided by the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency: Provided, That painting and marking of fire equipment not decided by the Fire Commissioner of the National Fire Agency shall be decided by the Mayor/Do Governor.
  (2) A person other than a fire service agency or a public official belonging thereto shall not use the painting or marking of fire equipment under paragraph (1) or similar painting or marking.
